terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.html:
These terms cover your use of Pekko, a service for showing images, videos, and playlists on screens ("the Service"). The Service is provided by Francisco Lopez, a sole proprietor doing business as Pekko ("we"). Pekko is owned entirely by Francisco Lopez. It is not a Pekko LLC and is wholly separate from Teamtegrate LLC.

Business address: 20227 Saticoy St, Apt 202, Winnetka, CA 91306, US.

By creating an account you agree to these terms and the Privacy Policy.

Accounts and content

Provide accurate account information and protect your sign-in credentials. You are responsible for the screens paired to your account and for content you upload. You retain ownership of your content and authorize Pekko to store, process, and deliver it to your screens to operate the Service. You confirm you have the rights to show it, and that it is not illegal, infringing, or harmful.

Do not try to access another customer's account or content, interfere with the Service, overload it, or use it to distribute malware or unlawful material. We may limit or suspend an account that does.

Plans and trial

Monthly prices, in US dollars, are Starter $19 for 1 screen, Business $39 for 3 screens, Multi-screen $59 for 5 screens. Each new organization receives a 14-day trial from creation, with up to 5 screens and no card required. After that trial, a separate 3-day playback grace lets screens continue playing before they may pause if a paid plan has not been started. That playback grace does not extend the 14-day trial.

Billing, cancellation, and existing customers

Stripe processes subscription payments, with Francisco Lopez, a sole proprietor doing business as Pekko as the seller, under standard Stripe Billing. Stripe is not the merchant of record. Pekko does not store card numbers. Payment receipts are sent by Stripe under its own customer-email settings. Pekko does not send a separate payment receipt. These terms do not enable Stripe Tax and do not set a tax rate. Publishing this page does not start a charge.

Monthly subscriptions renew until canceled. Canceling stops the next renewal and keeps access through the period already paid. On a lower screen limit, the account owner chooses which screens remain active within the plan limit. The others pause. Pausing because a trial ended, a payment failed, a subscription was canceled, or a screen is over the plan limit does not delete media, playlists, schedules, or settings. That is separate from an owner-requested account deletion.

Organizations that already existed before paid billing keep full access. They receive 14 days of continued full access after an advance billing notice is successfully sent. That countdown starts only when the notice email succeeds. It does not start when someone signs in, and publishing or reading this page is not that notice. Billing reminders and enforcement are separate switches and are not turned on by this page.

A failed subscription payment receives 7 days of playback grace from the first failed payment. A later failure in that same past-due period does not move the deadline. The dashboard shows the deadline to update payment details before playback may pause. Your content is not deleted.

Refunds

Monthly subscription payments are not refunded for unused time or a cancellation partway through a billing period, except where a refund is required by applicable law. Confirmed duplicate or incorrect charges will be corrected. Canceling stops the next renewal; access continues to the end of the period already paid.

Ending your account

You can stop using the Service at any time. The account owner can request deletion from Settings or at /account-deletion. Deletion runs 7 days after the request and can be canceled until then. We may suspend or close an account that breaks these terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.html:
This policy explains what Francisco Lopez, a sole proprietor doing business as Pekko processes when you use Pekko, why, and the choices the product actually offers. Pekko is owned entirely by Francisco Lopez. It is not a Pekko LLC and is wholly separate from Teamtegrate LLC.

Changes to this policy

Before a material change takes effect, the updated policy is posted on this page with its new effective date. The page stays linked from the site footer. When notice is required, or when notice is appropriate for an account whose email address Pekko has, that notice is sent to the account email. Pekko does not automatically email every edit of this page. Publishing this section does not send an email.

Information used to operate Pekko

  • Account. Email address, business name, an optional display name, and when the account was created and last signed in. Sign-in passwords are stored by Supabase Auth, not as plain text in Pekko's account rows.
  • Content and setup. Images, videos, menu boards, and brand settings you upload, plus playlists, schedules, promotions, locations, screen groups, and screen names.
  • Screens. For each paired screen: when it last checked in, what it reported playing, playback errors, offline periods, and a device token stored only as a hash. Nothing is collected about people walking past a screen.
  • First-party activity. Records of publishes, screen-content changes, pairing and removal, schedule changes, and uploads or deletions. Also hourly screen uptime and confirmed playback. Product milestones for the account record trial started, first screen paired, first publish, plan change, cancellation, how many screens were paired during the trial, and trial expired. Those milestone rows are not shown in your activity list.
  • Plan and billing. Plan, trial dates, subscription status, the current paid period, and Stripe customer and subscription identifiers when a paid subscription exists. Pekko does not store card numbers.
  • Mobile push. If you use the Pekko app and the device allows notifications, a push token for that device. To deliver notifications, Google's Firebase software in the app also creates a Firebase installation ID on the device and shares it with Google; Pekko does not store or use that ID.
  • Abuse limits and logs. Pairing attempts are limited using the request IP address as the rate-limit key. That key can remain in the rate-limit table; this application does not set a separate destruction date for it. Vercel error logs written by this app include the method, path, and a short message. They do not include headers, cookies, or request bodies.

Why it is used

To sign you in, store and deliver your content to your screens, show screen status, send account and screen alerts, run billing when a paid plan is started, measure which ads and channels bring new sign-ups, count visits to the public website, produce internal statistics about how the Service is used, support customers, limit abuse, and troubleshoot the Service. You keep ownership of your content. We do not sell personal information. There is no sale to opt out of, and this policy is not a claim of compliance with any particular privacy statute.

Who at Pekko can see your account details

A small number of authorized Pekko staff can see account and usage details on a private internal page, to support customers and run the Service. That page shows the account email and whether it is confirmed, the sign-up date, plan, trial and subscription status, whether screens are paired and have shown content, screen counts and the last check-in time, the date and type of the latest activity (including the last sign-in), whether the account is marked as internal or test, whether the account is marked for deletion, and the first-visit campaign source described below. It does not show passwords, payment card details, your uploaded content, playlists, menus, or messages. It reads the current account records, so a deleted account no longer appears there.

What is measured, and what is not

The records above are first-party records of the account's own screens and changes. This application does not include an advertising network or a third-party website-analytics script. The public website pages use Pekko's own cookieless visit counter, described below. The dashboard sign-in client stores the session in the browser and calls Pekko's API with a bearer token.

Transactional email goes through Resend as plain text. The send request does not turn on open or click tracking, and the verified pekkotv.com sending domain reports open and click tracking off. That describes this application and that domain setting. It is not a promise that a provider never logs or measures its own systems.

Ad and campaign attribution

When you first arrive at pekkotv.com, we may save campaign tags from the link (source, medium, campaign, content and term) and the address of the site that sent you (the referrer) in a first-party cookie and your browser's local storage for up to 90 days. If you create an account in that time, we copy this first-visit information to your account once, at sign-up, and we do not overwrite it later. We use it only to measure which ads and channels bring new sign-ups, and authorized Pekko staff can see an account's first-visit source on the internal page described above. We don't sell it or share it with advertisers or ad networks, and we don't use advertising pixels or third-party analytics scripts. The copy on your account is deleted when your account is deleted.

Website visit statistics

On the public pages of pekkotv.com (the home, features, pricing, FAQ, support and contact pages, in English and Spanish), Pekko counts visits with its own first-party counter. It sets no cookie and stores no IP address, browser fingerprint or persistent identifier. When one of these pages loads, your browser sends Pekko the page address without its query string. For the first page of a visit it also sends the address of the site that sent you, of which only the site name is kept, and any campaign tags in the link (source, medium and campaign). To count unique visitors, Pekko's server combines your IP address and your browser's user-agent string with a random value that changes every day, and turns them into a one-way code. The IP address and user-agent string are not saved. That code is kept only for the day it is made and is then replaced by a daily total. Each daily random value is deleted after two days, so visits can't be linked across days or traced back to you. What is kept is daily totals per page and traffic source, which authorized Pekko staff see on the internal page described above. These totals are deleted after 400 days. A per-tab flag in your browser's session storage, which is never sent to Pekko, tells the first page of a visit apart from later pages. Visits are not counted while you are signed in to Pekko, or when your browser sends a Global Privacy Control or Do Not Track signal. Dashboards, sign-in pages, the TV player and these legal pages are not counted. These statistics are not linked to any account and are not shared with advertisers or ad networks.

Service providers

  • Supabase provides the database, authentication, and file storage. The Pekko project reports region us-west-1. That is the project region, not a promise that every backup, log, or support access stays there.
  • Vercel hosts the website and API.
  • Stripe processes paid subscriptions when a paid plan is started, under standard Stripe Billing. Pekko is the seller. Publishing this policy does not enable charges.
  • Resend sends transactional service and billing email. The verified pekkotv.com sending domain reports region us-east-1. That is the sending region, not a promise that every Resend system stays there. The support address below receives mail on that domain. Use that address, not the billing sender, for privacy and support.
  • Google Firebase Cloud Messaging delivers mobile push notifications when a device token is registered and the device allows notifications. It receives the push token, the Firebase installation ID and the notification content.

No exclusive residency or cross-border-transfer assurance is made. A reported project or sending region is not a guarantee that all processing stays in that region.

How long it is kept

Account and content information is kept while the account is open, and longer where a provider backup or a legal need retains it. This application does not set Supabase's backup cycle or Stripe's billing-record period, so it does not state a number of days for either. Screen uptime, playback events, offline periods, activity records, and screen alerts are removed after 90 days. Trial expiry, a failed payment, or cancellation does not by itself delete content.

The account owner can update the display name, business name, and password in Settings, and can request account deletion in Settings or at /account-deletion. Deletion runs 7 days after the request and can be canceled until then. It removes the account, sign-in, content, and the records listed on that page. A deletion record of the account id, user id, and request dates is kept, without the email address or the content. Do not read the screen-preservation rule as a promise that provider backups or legally required billing records disappear immediately.

Choices

  • Update the display name, business name, and password in Settings. The account email is shown there.
  • Allow or refuse mobile notifications on the device, or turn push alerts off in Pekko Settings. A push token is stored only when notifications are used.
  • Cancel a subscription from the billing portal Stripe provides after a paid plan exists. Cancellation stops the next renewal.
  • Choose which screens stay active when a plan includes fewer screens. The others pause. Content is kept.
  • Request deletion, or cancel a pending deletion, as described above.
  • Email the contact below for a privacy request about your account. We may need to confirm that you control the account before acting on it.

Children

Pekko is for businesses and is not directed to children under 13.
